qwen.root_cause: The pinned revision is present in the hub cache, but from_pretrained resolves the model without the explicit revision / local snapshot path and therefore falls back to a network lookup that the compute node cannot complete.
qwen.remedy: Pass revision=QWEN_REV (or the local snapshot directory) to the text-backbone loader, or set local_files_only=True after cache preparation. Requires a source change and a fresh Gate run.

note: File-level SHA-256 values were computed by the Gate into weight_and_asset_manifest.json on the deployment root.
